name: node
why: Runs every TS package, tests and scripts; CI uses Node 24 (see .nvmrc).

name: pnpm
why: The only package manager for this monorepo (AGENTS.md); version pinned in package.json packageManager.

name: rustup
why: Installs the Rust toolchain pinned in rust-toolchain.toml for the rust/ N-API crate (cargo, clippy, rustfmt).

name: cargo-deny
why: Supply-chain gate for rust/ (advisories, licenses, bans, sources per rust/deny.toml); runs in CI audit.yml.

name: docker
why: Builds the Linux FFI binary exactly as CI does (rust/Dockerfile.linux).
